# Discover and call UNS without reading source code

> Current data contract data/3: Collection-scoped Record actions and /uns/records:transact replace duplicate data routes. Samples use samples:find/aggregate/latest/delete; append to /records/{recordId}/samples. Find/aggregate require from/to and support multiple optional recordIds; latest/delete require explicit recordIds. Find and write snapshots share canonical resource objects with business fields under data; query paths remain bare business fields and _id/_meta.*. See the [data contract](tier0://mcp/skill-docs/doc/uns-v2/data-api.md).

1. Call `instance_capabilities` for the deployed version, authorized tools and boundaries.
2. Call `api_operations_list` with `{}`. HTTP operation/operationId names differ from batch `items[].action` values. Unknown names return candidates without execution.
3. Call `api_contract_get`, for example with `{"kinds":["directory","topic","collection","source","stream","app","record","sample","release"]}`. Read model definitions, request/response schemas, relationships and constraints. HTTP responseSchema describes the envelope; MCP structuredContent returns its dataSchema.
4. Call `api_examples_get`, for example with `{"operations":["recordFind"],"client":"mcp"}`, for a same-version example. Replace IDs and names with real authorized objects.
5. Use Collection-scoped document actions for Record CUD and items arrays for Sample append. Use /uns/records:transact with dryRun for business composition and metadata:transact for metadata. Discover actual MCP tool names from the catalog. Optional caller retry keys preserve retry intent; query accepted jobId and inspect state after timeouts.

## Safe configuration edits

Use `uns_objects_query` for authorized kinds/IDs and current revisions. Redacted projections are not complete replacement documents. Use `meta.patch` with kind, id and only intended data changes; expectedRevision is optional for every metadata kind, and supplied values must match. Objects merge recursively, arrays replace, null removes; omitted fields are preserved. Server-owned fields cannot be patched. Read a fresh revision and preview after conflicts. Never write back `[REDACTED]`.

## Boundaries

Source binding instances reference reusable Stream releases and explicit target Collections. Topic placement does not determine data identity. Draft saving, release publication and actual acquisition/execution are separate. Create Bindings disabled, then use the dedicated state/update lifecycle and verify runtime state and actual data. Complete programs use program/* with explicit deployment/execution scopes. MCP does not mint credentials.

App tools manage authorized Collection grants and navigation, preserving members/roles. Navigation does not grant data access. App key issuance, member/role management and arbitrary impersonation are not MCP operations.

Reserved source_plan/source_version/subscription kinds have no public CRUD contract. Runtime state is read-only and may be absent. Structured errors include code, opId, object identity, field path, reason, repair and unknown-name candidates. Correct the indicated contract violation and preview with a new key; never infer joins or bypass permission checks.
